title: Hybris stock stores
subtitle: The stores whose stock OMS sends to the website (Hybris), and how each one's sync is doing.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Hybris stock view grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: Required. It is kept with the change.

off.title: The Hybris stock sync is off
off.body: Nothing is sent to Hybris. Special stores and material edits still take effect once it is switched on.

shadow.title: Shadow mode
shadow.body: Files are written to a shadow path that Hybris does not import, so the website does not change.

live.title: Live
live.body: Files are delivered to Hybris's hot folder. Hybris imports them on its own schedule.

unknown.title: Sync mode unknown
unknown.body: The rail's mode could not be read. Do not assume it is live.

results.failedTitle: The stores could not be loaded
results.viewOnly: View only: marking stores and push now need the Hybris stock manage grant.

cause.deltaBehind: no successful delta for more than two intervals

mark.title: Make a special store (full sync)
mark.note: <store>{{store}}</store> becomes a special store: it gets a full of every enabled material now, and joins the nightly full cycle.
mark.doneDetail: Store {{store}} is a special store. A full is on its way.

unmark.title: Remove this special store
unmark.note: <store>{{store}}</store> leaves the nightly full cycle. If all open stores are synced, its deltas continue; otherwise OMS stops sending its stock, and Hybris keeps what it was last sent.
unmark.doneDetail: Store {{store}} is no longer a special store.

pushNow.title: Push this store now
pushNow.note: Sends a FULL of every enabled material for <store>{{store}}</store> now. It counts as the store's full, so the nightly cycle does not send it again tonight.
pushNow.doneDetail: Store {{store}}: {{rows}} rows. See the result above the list.

result.E: <n>{{rows}}</n> rows, failed. See the push log.

refusal.busy: A push of this store is already running; try again shortly.
refusal.busyHint: Nothing was pushed or recorded. Try again shortly.
refusal.notMarked: A chosen store is not a Hybris stock store.
refusal.notMarkedHint: Make it special first (or have all open stores synced); the list is read again.
refusal.railOff: The Hybris stock sync is off.
refusal.railOffHint: Nothing can be pushed until it is switched on.
refusal.materialNotEnabled: A chosen material is not an enabled Hybris stock material.
refusal.materialNotEnabledHint: Nothing was pushed. Push only enabled materials, or enable it on the Materials page.
refusal.selection: The choice of stores and materials was refused.
refusal.selectionHint: Choose at least one store and one material, at most 200 stores and 1,000 materials.

pushMaterials.title: Push chosen materials now
pushMaterials.note: Sends the current stock of the chosen materials for the chosen stores now. It does not count as a full and does not change when their next delta runs.
pushMaterials.doneDetail: {{rows}} rows. See the result above the list.
pushMaterials.tooManyStores: At most {{max}} stores in one push.
pushMaterials.tooManyMaterials: At most {{max}} materials in one push.

history.failed: The history could not be loaded
history.empty: This store has never been marked.

disable.title: Disable this store
disable.note: OMS stops sending the stock of <store>{{store}}</store>, special or not. Nothing is sent to Hybris: it keeps the stock it was last sent.
disable.doneDetail: Store {{store}} is no longer synced to Hybris.

enable.title: Enable this store
enable.note: <store>{{store}}</store> is synced again: its next delta carries what changed while it was disabled.
enable.doneDetail: Store {{store}} is synced to Hybris again.
